claim_levels: The canonical root changes an original piece's control or support function.
An original friendly actor can legally use that resource at this exact current decision.
A full legal survey selects the strongest returned other own plan; one matching-level pair values both choices.
A current full reply survey identifies the resource's actual strongest and returned near-leading resistance.
Those same histories and physical prices, rather than an incidental old capture/PV, determine the bounded root explanation.
critical_counterexample: After Nc4/Qb7, Black's original Ne8 still controls d6. White can legally play Rd6 and Nxd6, yet ...Nxd6 exchanges a knight for the rook. After Nc4/Nef6 or Nc4/Nc7 the original defender has moved away. A legal Qxd6/Nxd6 proof is not a general resource-value certificate.
necessary_realization_boundary: The original friendly resource actor, destination and current provider/control must be reread. The old Qxd6 transition belongs to its conditional history. If Qxd6 is illegal in the current realization, no acceptance comparison is invented. A new plan's usefulness cannot inherit the old d6-function title without its own dependence proof.
shared_certificate: CommentaryChoiceValue: owned unrestricted survey -> strongest returned other -> exact same-position and completed-depth pair, with both values from that pair. Exact prefix/position/occurrence/profile ownership is retained.
scheduling: One finite current resource task and its already owned first-response group. Complete only its missing surveys, exact selected pairs and current response/price obligations within the original deadline. Earlier seed requirements remain historical, never current strongest-choice obligations. Returned alternatives do not recursively seed new resource tasks.
delivery: Use existing structured statements and closure. Preserve true conditional facts when a utility question is refuted or unknown. Give a different good own plan its separate verified scope. Do not replace the root grade with child scores or call the local function its sole numerical cause.
falsifiers: The named resource is illegal, its original actor is absent, or its alleged provider/control is no longer present at the current decision.
The stronger current defender changes the price or defeats the resource, even though a cooperating capture still permits recapture.
A restricted pair or arbitrary legal seed is presented as the best legal competitor.
Two values are spliced across different works, prefixes, original pieces, profiles or completed numerical levels.
A different useful plan or equal score is treated as proof of the original function's cause.
A selected useful realization's observed capture, check response, support loss or promotion price is omitted.
scope: This plan registers the implementation direction after completing the initial actual-defense studies. Standalone research values remain separate from product receipts and the official root assessment. It is not a completed outcome or a rescore of the four fixed human cases.
